question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>L</mi></math> be a common tangent line to the curves <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>9</mn><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>36</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi></mrow></mfenced><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>31</mn></math>. Then the square of the slope of the line <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>L</mi></math> is ______.<gwmw style="display:none;"></gwmw>

solution.text:
Given curves are x29+y24=1

x2+y2=314

let slope of common tangent be m

so tangents are y=mx±9m2+4

y=mx±3121+m2

hence 9m2+4=3141+m2

⇒36m2+16=31+31m2⇒m2=3
